rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that in furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 05th March 2025 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, the Company received a Stay Order from the Hon'ble High Court of Gujarat at Ahmedabad in connection with the Show Cause Notice received by the Company.

rows.title: Disclosure of material issue
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed that in furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 05th March 2025 and pursuant to Regulation 30(13) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations,  the Company received a Stay Order from the Hon'ble High Court of Gujarat at Ahmedabad in connection with the Show Cause Notice received by the Company.

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Company and Ascent-K Circuit Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary of the Company, have been allotted land by the YEIDA for the establishment of new manufacturing facilities.

rows.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018, we are hereby enclosing the certificate received from KFin Technologies Limited, the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent of the Company, for the quarter ended 31 December 2025.

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations,  Ascent-K Circuit Private Limited and Shogini Technoarts Pvt Ltd, step-down subsidiaries of the Company, have received formal approval under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS), today i.e. on 02nd January 2026.

rows.title: Acquisition
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, material subsidiary of the Company has further acquired stake in the equity share capital of Unitronics (1989) (R"G) Ltd. through ILJIN Holding Ltd, the wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited.

rows.title: Trading Window
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company is planning to invest Rs. 500 Crore for expansion of its state-of-the-art Research & Development (R&D) Centre in Punjab.

rows.title: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet the Analyst/ Investors on 12th December, 2025, at 10:00 A.M. IST in Mumbai.

rows.title: Acquisition
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company, has acquired 80% stake in the equity share capital of Shogini Technoarts Pvt Ltd on 1 December 2025, for a total purchase consideration of approximately Rs. 506 Crore.

rows.title: Acquisition
rows.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited ( IL JIN ), a material subsidiary of the Company, has further indirectly acquired 0.96% stake in the equity share capital of (1989) (R"G) Ltd., through ILJIN Holding Ltd, an Israel based wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN.
